notes: Items and money. You and every character now carry real things and real money (Dennies in Zenless worlds, dollars elsewhere; change the name, symbol and price scale in Bag & money). Nangong can afford anything, Cissia is always broke, and nobody can pay with money they don't have.

Shops: every world gets convenience stores, pharmacies, grocery stores, cafés, clothing, florists, gift shops, liquor stores and an adult boutique, with opening hours, prices and stock that can sell out. New Eridu uses its own places (141, JC Pharmacy, Lumina Galleria, Richard Teamilk, Peace Herbal, Yum Cha Sin…). Browse them in 🗺 World → 🛍 Shops and buy when you're there.
Anyone under 18 waits outside 18+ shops and can't buy alcohol, cigarettes or adult items.

Items do things over time: melatonin makes you drowsy half an hour later, Pepto settles a stomach, coffee and energy drinks wire you up (and crash), drinks add up from tipsy to wasted with a hangover the next morning, heat patches ease cramps, aphrodisiacs work only on adults and never decide anything for anyone. Food spoils, coffee goes cold, ice cream melts.

The story can buy, use, give and pay: characters hand each other things, split bills, pay for taxis and buy things off-screen too. See Schedules → Bag & money for your bag, everyone's wallet and recent spending.
